new.doc: `SmHashTable::IncMaxItemCount` ([`crate::geom::hash_table::HashTable::inc_max_item_count_with_fixes`], [`crate::geom::hash_table::HashTable::add_with_fixes`], and [`crate::geom::hash_table::ObjsInVoxels::add_with_fixes`]) preserves existing removed `SmBucketItem` records (`bucket_index == None`, `item`, `item_id`) when growing the item array while `GetUsedBucketItemCount() == 0` (`GetTotalBucketItemCount() > 0`), so a subsequent `Remove` skips already-removed slots instead of walking bucket `0` on `calloc`-zeroed records (`bucket_index == 0`, `item == NULL`, `item_id == 0`) and incrementing the removed-item counter past the total item count (WR-13, #2200; see `plan/upstream-issues/WR-13--addendum-2026-11-01-preserve-removed-records-on-grow.md`).

`SmTransform::EvaluateBoundingBoxSimple`'s aligned-basis fast path maps parameter intervals by multiplying by each axis column's length (`|x|`, `|y|`, `|z|`) and translating by the origin's component along each transformed basis vector (`o_u * |x|`, `o_v * |y|`, `o_w * |z|` where `(o_u, o_v, o_w) = T_lin^-1(o)`), permutes parameter axis `k`'s interval into basis slot `|alAxisMap[k]| - 1` (negated when `alAxisMap[k] < 0`), circumscribes an axis-aligned projected `PseudoBox` into `pOptProjBox` by basis (`WR-5`), and falls back to the general corner/unbounded branch when the transform's linear part is singular, instead of scaling by `1 / |axis|`, translating by `o · axis`, and indexing `sIvls[|alAxisMap[k]| - 1]` (WR-8, #2148; see `plan/upstream-issues/WR-8--addendum-2026-10-31-aligned-bbox-image.md`).

`SmBSplineCurve::CreateSimpleOffset` passes `false` for `ApproximateCurve`'s `bOptCreateAnalytics` and forwards `bOptMatchParameterization` in its own slot instead of passing `(bOptMatchParameterization, FALSE)` (WR-37, #2141; see `plan/upstream-issues/WR-37--addendum-2026-10-31-simple-offset-match-param.md`).

`SmBendVolume::EvaluateBoundingBoxSimple` builds the mid-angle `PseudoBox` (`proj_pseudo_box`) from the true radial/angular cosine and sine extrema over `[u_min, u_max] × [-half_angle, half_angle]` (propagating `±SM_INFINITE_PARAMETER` along unbounded `u` rays) instead of `sin(theta_end) * u_min` / `sin(theta_end) * u_max` compared against `SM_PI`, and uses `max(sin(theta_min), sin(theta_max)) * u_min` instead of cosines for the axis-aligned box's `dYMax` when `u` reaches `SM_INFINITE_PARAMETER` and both end angles are `<= 0` (`WR-59`; see `plan/upstream-issues/WR-59--addendum-2026-11-01-bend-volume-pseudo-box-bounds.md`).

`SmBendVolume::TrimParamBoundingBoxSimple` trims `v` periodically to the primary period `[-pi * |d|, pi * |d|]` — shifting intervals of length `< 2 * pi * |d|` into the primary period when they do not straddle the seam `±pi * |d|` (within `SM_EFF_ZERO`) and expanding seam-crossing or full-period/unbounded intervals to `[-pi * |d|, pi * |d|]` — instead of rejecting shifted-period boxes and clamping `v_min` and `v_max` independently with `SM_CLAMP_TO_PERIOD`, which inverts seam-crossing intervals and leaves `trim_box` holding stale caller data while returning `SM_SUCCESS` (`WR-60`; see `plan/upstream-issues/WR-60--addendum-2026-11-01-bend-volume-trim-across-period.md`).

`sm_SrfSrfIntersection` traces the curve of a surface and a plane between two points on both, where the surface is not flat and they cross at both, on the plane's equation (`sm_SurfacePlaneCurve`): the plane, unbounded, does not end the curve, where upstream's analytic intersector stops at the plane's domain, the face it was made for, and its two-points intersector marches both surfaces in their domains.

`SmPointSet3d::SetUpTightPseudoBox` assigns the projected points returned by `SmVector3d::ProjectPointToPlane(sPlanePoint, sPlaneZ)` on the four `basis[0]` / `basis[1]` boundary points and each candidate point before forming chord vectors for `CCWAngleBetween`, instead of calling the `const` `ProjectPointToPlane` and discarding its return value so angles are measured between unprojected 3D points (WR-14, #2201; see `plan/upstream-issues/WR-14--addendum-2026-11-01-project-tight-pbox-points.md`).
`SmOffsetExecutive::MapEdgeuses` raises each offset edge it matches to an original edge to that edge's tolerance, and the offset edge's vertices to the original edge's vertices' largest.

`SmSurface::FindDegenParamForDirection` compares the actual singular parameter mapped into `sSIvl` (`s_ivl.evaluate(this_param)` and `s_ivl.evaluate(near_best_param)`) with the caller's singular parameter `dS` in the "nearly as good and closer to the input" tie-break, so the nearest candidate starting guess is chosen on degenerate boundaries whose singular domain is not `[0, 1]`; pinned v1.0.1 compares the `[0, 1]` sample fractions `dThisParam` and `dNearBestParam` directly against `dS` (WR-57, #2209; `plan/upstream-issues/WR-57--addendum-2026-11-01-degen-param-tiebreak.md`).

`smgu_BestFitLineToPoints` takes the unit eigenvector of the largest eigenvalue of the symmetric scatter matrix `M = sum_i Y_i Y_i^T` (`vectors[2]` of `Compute3x3EigenVectors`, maximising `v^T M v` and minimising the sum of squared orthogonal distances `tr(M) - v^T M v`), leaving `M` unmodified for `smgu_BestFitPlaneToPoints`, and `SmPointSet3d::SetUpAxes` forwards the setting when built with a kernel.

`smgu_CircleFindSilhouettePoints` in perspective rotates the unit direction from the circle centre toward the projected eye point (`proj_eye - center`) as a pure vector about the circle normal by `±acos(radius / dist)` and offsets the scaled radius vectors by `circle_center`, returning `None` when the circle normal is degenerate.

`SmEllipse::ConvertTo2D` solves the extremal projected-radius quadratic with coefficients in `SolveQuadraticEqn`'s ascending `[C, B, A]` order, evaluates the second semi-axis at the orthogonal angle `dThetaYRad` (`theta_x_rad + PI / 2` when linear) instead of reusing `dThetaXRad`, and aligns a full-turn STEP domain with the projected NURB seam before rebuilding the polar converter (WR-31, #2140; `plan/upstream-issues/WR-31--addendum-2026-10-31-convert-to-2d-second-axis.md`).
`SmCircle::CreateSimpleOffset` distinguishes antiparallel offset plane normals from parallel ones, subtracting offset distance rather than adding it (WR-32, 2026-10-31 addendum).

`SmTArray::FindElementInMaskedArray` (called by `sms_FindAndClassifyLoopBisector` on `SmFaceProps::m_sPolePoints` with `m_lPoles`) tests each element `ii`'s own bit `(mask & (1 << ii)) != 0` (shift-safe: `0` for `ii >= 64`) so edge midpoints on any singular side (`SS_UMIN` `1`, `SS_VMIN` `2`, `SS_UMAX` `4`, `SS_VMAX` `8`) are skipped and non-singular `SS_UMAX`/`SS_VMAX` slots are not falsely matched when `SS_UMIN` is set; pinned v1.0.1 evaluates `(lBitMask & (1 < ii)) != 0`, never matching indices `0` or `1` and testing indices `2..` against bit `0` (`SS_UMIN`) (WR-167, #2172; `plan/upstream-issues/WR-167--addendum-2026-11-01-masked-array-bit-shift.md`).

`SmConic::Evaluate` ([`crate::curve::conic::Conic::evaluate_with_fixes`], forwarded by [`crate::curve::curve::Curve::evaluate`], [`crate::curve::curve::Curve::evaluate_into`], and `<Conic as CurveEvaluate>::evaluate`) uses the computed second derivative `sSec` when `bNonZeroTangents` replaces a near-zero first derivative (`|C'| < 1.1 * dScaledZero`) for `lNumDerivatives == 2`, scaling `sSec` to `1.1 * dScaledZero` (negated above the natural interval midpoint) when `|sSec| > 1.1 * dScaledZero`.

`SmGlobalSolver::IdenticalSolutions` prefers the solution with the larger `m_vStart.m_dSolutionValue` when the solver operation is a plain maximisation (`SM_SO_MAXIMIZE`, `SM_SO_DIRECTED_MAXIMIZE`, `SM_SO_PROJECTED_MAXIMIZE`), so an interior maximum is not replaced by a nearby span-boundary candidate within `SM_EFF_ZERO_SQRT` in value and `dScaledZero` in parameter; pinned v1.0.1 always prefers `<` (WR-21, #2155; `plan/upstream-issues/WR-21--addendum-2026-10-31-identical-maximize-preferred.md`).
`SmSurfaceCache::GetSurfaceContinuity` checks the last internal V knot (`iv + 1 < rVConts.GetSize()`) rather than skipping it (`iv + 1 < rVConts.GetSize() - 1`) (WR-42).

`SmSurfacePointSolver::SmSurfacePointSolver` returns the failing status of `SmSurface::CalculateBoundingBox` when `eSolverOp == SM_SO_3D_SIGNED_DIRECTED_MAXIMIZE` instead of ignoring it and setting `m_sTestPt` from a corner of the uninitialised inside-out `SmExtent3d` (`±1.4 * SM_BIG_DOUBLE`, on the wrong side of the surface) (WR-72, #2169; `plan/upstream-issues/WR-72--addendum-2026-11-01-propagate-bbox-failure.md`).

`smvol_LiftThirdDerivative` (surface and volume forms) uses `Dxzz` instead of `Dxxz` for the `x z^2` outer-derivative term in `Duuv`, `Duvv`, `Duuw`, `Duww`, `Dvvw`, and `Dvww`, and builds the volume form's `Duww` and `Dvww` from `Fuw`/`Fw` and `Fvw`/`Fw` instead of `Fuv`/`Fv` and `Fvv`/`Fv` (WR-45, #2165; see `plan/upstream-issues/WR-45--addendum-2026-10-31-lift-third-derivative-terms.md`).

`SmSurface::DropCurve` gives a curve lying on a cylinder (an `SmCylinder`, or an `SmCone` of zero semi-angle) its exact UV curve: a plane section (the ellipse, circle or line a plane cuts from the cylinder, as the boolean's plane/cylinder edges and an exact round's rails are) is a rational B-spline in the cylinder's rational parameters, built in the curve's own parameter with twice its degree, where upstream traces and fits a cubic within the drop tolerance: the trims of a tilted peg's rim sat 2e-6 to 1e-5 off their edge, and the cylinder face's area and the body's volume carried that error (WR-680, #2109; see `plan/upstream-issues/WR-680--cylinder-plane-section-uv-trims-are-fits.md`).

`SmCurveClassification::Intersect3DDiscontinuities(const SmVolume&, ...)` checks `m_bUnalignedU || m_bUnalignedV || m_bUnalignedW` instead of testing `m_bUnalignedU` three times, so unaligned `V` or `W` discontinuities return `SM_ERR` rather than proceeding to build constant-parameter planes across them (WR-156, #2171; `plan/upstream-issues/WR-156--addendum-2026-11-01-check-vw-unaligned.md`).
`SmPeriodicExtent1d::AddInterval` on an empty extent sets `[from, to]` rather than assuming the full period `[0, period]` (WR-6, 2026-10-31 addendum).

`SmSurface::LocalSurfaceIntersect`'s out-of-bounds boundary retries guard both the minimum and maximum boundary tests of the second through fourth parameter branches (`v` of `this`, `u` of `other`, `v` of `other`) with `!bFoundSolution`, matching step 1, instead of binding `!bFoundSolution` only to the minimum test via `!bFoundSolution && min || max` and re-running `sm_IntersectSrfBndryCrv` at a maximum boundary where a failed solve overwrites an already-found boundary solution (WR-99, #2210; `plan/upstream-issues/WR-99--addendum-2026-11-01-guard-max-boundary-retry.md`).

`SmTrackTopologyChanges::StopTracking` clears the context's system notify callback and records post-edit dependencies only when the context's currently installed callback is this tracker's own (`IsTracking`), instead of whenever `m_pLastNotifyCallback == NULL` — which also fires when a tracker was constructed with `bStartNow = FALSE` and never started, or when another caller replaced this tracker's callback before `StopTracking` ran (WR-17, #2149; see `plan/upstream-issues/WR-17--addendum-2026-10-31-stop-tracking-own-callback.md`).

`SmPlane::Reparameterize` moves the placement origin to `sOriginMax` when the UV domain is reparameterized, maintaining consistency between analytic plane and NURB evaluations across shifted domains; upstream computes `sOriginMax` but only references it under `SM_DEBUG_CODE` (WR-41).

`SmCrvInVolume::GenerateMults` reads the cached continuity at the matched break index `bi` (`m_sConts[bi]`) instead of the query knot index `ii` (`m_sConts[ii]`), so cached `GetKnots` sub-interval queries and `GenerateMults` subsets or non-break query points return each matched break's own effective multiplicity (WR-33, #2143; see `plan/upstream-issues/WR-33--addendum-2026-10-31-mults-break-index.md`).

`SmCurveBoundedSurface::ReadFromDB` dispatches each UV boundary curve on its own stream header type (`lUVType`) instead of reusing the last 3D boundary's type (`l3DType`, `0` when there are no 3D boundaries), and passes the read `bImplicitOuter` flag to the constructed `SmCurveBoundedSurface` instead of dropping it and defaulting to `false` (WR-43, #2164; see `plan/upstream-issues/WR-43--addendum-2026-10-31-read-uv-type-and-implicit-outer.md`).

`TrimExtendedEdge` never takes an open edge's first trim point again as its second, by point as well as by parameter: on the closed curve a rim half of a sphere cap lifts onto (the whole offset circle), the first point's twin across the curve's seam (another parameter, the same point, often the far end of the coincident range the other rim half's offset gives) is refused, so the half no longer gets the whole circle (or nothing) and its offset loop no gap.

`SmCone::CreateCanonical` (`Cone::create_canonical_with_semi_angle` and `Cone::create_canonical`) passes `inside_out` as the bounded cone constructor's `bInsideOut` and `false` as `bMakeNurbGenCurve` when `height` is `Some` (where upstream passes `FALSE` for `bInsideOut` and the caller's `bInsideOut` for `bMakeNurbGenCurve`, dropping an inside-out request), and rejects `height <= 0.0` in the two-radius overload with `SolidError::InvalidInput` (`SM_ERR_INVALID_INPUT`) instead of forwarding `top_radius` as the semi-angle in degrees of an unbounded cone (WR-63, #2207; see `plan/upstream-issues/WR-63--addendum-2026-11-01-cone-create-canonical-args.md`).

`SmSurfaceIntersector::DoIntersection` splits each traced crossing (or near-tangent) B-spline curve, with its two UV curves, where it passes through a singular point of the intersection (the normals parallel while two branches cross): `|n1 x n2|` is sampled 8 times per knot span, each sharp minimum refined by golden section, and the curve split where the sine is below 1e-6 and rises above 1e-3 again on both sides, more than 10 approximation tolerances from its ends; the tails are appended.

`SmPointClassification::GetGap3d(pOptSurface)` returns `Err(SM_ERR)` (and propagates object-point, surface-drop, and surface-evaluation failures) when the object point has no single drop point on `pOptSurface` even at `100 * sObjZoneTol3d` (WR-58).

`SmBSplineSurface::IsParallelToVector` (and `SmPlane`'s inherited branch) returns `false` when `vector` cannot be unitised, and tests subsequent control points of each row or column against the chord direction `(line_end - line_pnt).unitize()` rather than `line_end`.

A round whose filleted edge runs on tangentially at a vertex into an edge of its own convexity that its rail on that face runs alongside and never meets (an R2 corner arc of a plate's outline between straight sides, picked alone) ends at its section through the vertex: the round is cut there by the plane normal to the filleted edge, and the region between the round, its faces and the end sections is subtracted from the body, a flat end face (the section's corner) left on each such end.

`SmFilletVertex::CalcRailIntExtendedEdgeuse`, outside the 3x2 mixed-convexity corner, takes a rail end of type `SM_FV_RAIL_X_EXTENDED_EDGEUSE` classed on a side edge use as the solver's rail/edge crossing (`CalcRailIntEdgeuse`, which `RailEdgeuseIntersect` finds on the edge or its continuation) when that point lies on the end face's extended surface within the solver's approximation tolerance, passes it to `sm_SrfSrfIntersection` as the second known point, and trims the end curve between the two rail ends (failing with `SM_FIL_SURF_INT_FAILURE` when either is more than ten times that tolerance off it); otherwise the vertex is reset to unprocessed and its end is, as upstream, where the fillet surface's intersection with the end face, marched from the other rail's end, leaves the fillet surface.

A blend-curve fillet (`SM_FSG_BLEND_CURVE`) is built by the G^n section generator ([`crate::blend::fillet_section::section::GnSectionFsg`], the fork's `SmGnSectionFSG`) in place of `SmBlendCurveCrossSectionFSG`: the section of order n = continuity (2 to 4) and thumbweight w (in (-1, 1), or `GN_THUMBWEIGHT_EQUAL_AREA` = -2, the default: the w at which the section takes off the area the ball's circle does, resolved once per generator from the wedge at the first blend's middle station and shared by every solver of that generator; the fork's 6148773 = d01d7b0's 1947a45), `S(t) = f T1(1 - p1) + (1 - f) T2(p2)` over the faces' order-n jets along the rails, a rational Bezier section times the jets' cubic Hermite curves along the rails, certified span by span within a tenth of the fillet's tolerance; its contact with each face is of order n + 1 (n + 2 between planes).
